creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/FM/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -I -B assets/audio/bgm_star_quarry/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python) and Node 24 (v24.12.0 used). render.py runs studio/audio/cli.mjs on score.json; the output parent directory must exist.
patch: Studio audio score, MT19937 seed 6303. Voices: struck stone (additive partials 1, 2, 3, 5 with decays of 0.9 to 3.2 per second, a short noise knock) on C3, G3, D3, G2, E3 four seconds apart; crystal ring (sine with FM ratio 3.5 index 0.9 plus an inharmonic 2.76x partial) on E5-C6, a few rings per four bars; a quiet two-sine floor C2+G2 across the loop. Seeded-noise impulse reverb 3.4 s, wet 0.45, folded across the loop boundary.
tuning: C major pentatonic (C D E G A), tonal center C; A4 = 440 Hz
register_note: Stone strikes sit between 65 and 400 Hz; crystal rings sit between 650 Hz and 1.1 kHz at the fundamental with partials into the 1.6-5 kHz band, which holds -21.7 dB of total energy: the highest of the three beds, so the tell is most at risk here and needs listening. Measured mono energy share (engine bands): 0-100 Hz -7.34 dB, 100-450 Hz -1.03 dB, 450-1600 Hz -17.01 dB, 1600-5000 Hz -21.73 dB, 5000-22050 Hz -37.49 dB.
structure: 20 bars, a stone strike on beat 1 of every two-bar pair and a softer second strike four beats later, so strikes are four seconds apart at 60 BPM; five crystal phrases at bars 2, 6, 10, 14, 18 (two or three rings each). The long reverb (3.4 s) carries across the loop boundary.
proposal: Tempo, length, loop point and structure are the author's proposal (docs/AUDIO_DESIGN.md, 'Branches proposal'); the project owner chose only the one-sentence brief.
loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: Notes, drone and reverb tails wrap modulo the loop; frame 0 continues from frame loopEnd - 1.

verification.rebuild: Rendered by the Studio audio engine; render twice gives byte-identical WAV (tools/tests/test_audio_branches.py rebuilds into a scratch directory and compares).
verification.meter: Studio audio engine measure (BS.1770 K-weighted LUFS, 4x oversampled true-peak estimate); pack evidence re-measures with the pinned FFmpeg 6.1.1 ebur128.
verification.scale_check: Every pitched note is inside the declared pentatonic (key.enforce true; the engine raises out_of_scale otherwise).
